data.gender_notes: Orlando is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Orlando is derived from the Latin word 'Orlannus', which means 'glory of the famous man' or 'land of the lion'. In Christian tradition, it is believed that the name was given to the Roman saint Orlando, who was a brave knight and a patron of soldiers. The name Orlando carries the meaning “Land of the lion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Orlando usually hope their child will grow to embody land of the lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
